achievements.name: Repurposed

achievements.description: Drink all the wine brewed by Shennong.

achievements.description: Defeat every optional miniboss.

achievements.name: What Have You Done?!
achievements.description: Break the clay pot made by Shuanshuan

achievements.description: Defeat Tianshou while driving a robot.

achievements.name: Gimme Gimme
